description: Pick a preset (clean, midnight, sunset, ocean, forest, paper, neon, bubblegum, linen, monochrome, stone, electric, poster, cherry, peach, lavender, mint, sky, noir, aurora, ember, slate, evergreen, harvest) and/or override parts of it. Colors are "#rrggbb". Switching preset resets colors to that preset before applying overrides.

background.description: One color for solid, 2–3 for a gradient.

backgroundBlur.description: Blur for the photo or video background, 0–20 pixels.

backgroundDim.description: How much to darken the photo or video background so text stays readable, 0–80 percent.

backgroundImageUrl.description: An https link to a PNG, JPEG or WebP photo (up to 2 MB) to show behind the page. "" removes the photo or video background.

buttonStyle.description: soft is frosted glass (the editor calls it Glass); shadow is a solid button with a hard black offset shadow.

coverImageUrl.description: Banner layout: an https link to a wide PNG, JPEG or WebP photo (up to 2 MB). "" removes it.

font.description: Body text and buttons. System fonts: sans, serif, rounded, mono. Web fonts: inter, dm-sans, space-grotesk, poppins, montserrat, playfair-display, lora, fraunces, dm-serif-display, hepta-slab, nunito, quicksand, caveat, pacifico, jetbrains-mono, space-mono, bebas-neue, archivo-black. Fonts with only one weight (dm-serif-display, pacifico, bebas-neue, archivo-black) suit headingFont better.

headerLayout.description: classic: the photo over the name; hero: the photo large on top; banner: a wide cover photo (set coverImageUrl) with the photo over its edge.

headingFont.description: The font for the name and section headers; null uses the body font.

logoUrl.description: An https link to a logo (PNG or WebP with transparency is best) shown instead of the name. "" removes it and shows the name again.

photoShape.description: The profile photo's shape in classic and banner layouts.

name: set_theme
title: Change the look
